links.outcome: Accuracy and abstention rate when uncertain samples are rejected for human review versus baseline
links.effect: On MIMIC-III, PEER reached 90.73% accuracy versus 89.48% baseline by rejecting only 2.79% of uncertain samples.
links.quote: For instance, on the MIMIC-III dataset, PEER achieves an accuracy of 90.73% (surpassing the baseline of 89.48%) by rejecting only 2.79% of uncertain samples.

unlisted_practices: Patience-based early exiting with a rejection mechanism to speed up inference while abstaining on uncertain cases

screen.reason: Evaluates an uncertainty rejection / selective abstention guardrail (early exiting with rejection) added across standard biomedical benchmark datasets and models to defer ambiguous cases.

primary.practice: selective abstention / rejection mechanism under uncertainty
